purpose: Record historical public evidence that a legacy NeuRosetta implementation available before the December 2025 Point_data artifact contained subtree, simplification, nearest-vertex mapping, and coordinate normalization capabilities relevant to the missing morphology pipeline.

latest_public_commit_before_point_data.message: mainly load mesh file added and fixes to sub tree identification

subtree_commit.evidence: Neurosetta/graphs.py added g_subtree(), g_subtree_mask(), get_sub_tree_quality(), optimal_partition_root(), and simplify_neuron().

subtree_index_fix.evidence: optimal_partition_root() was changed to score simplified-graph branches and then map the selected simplified root coordinate back to the full neuron with nearest_vertex().

swc_writer.evidence: Neurosetta/core.py contains write_swc(), exporting a Tree_graph through graph_to_table().

subtree_selection.mechanism: Find candidate dendritic subtree roots on a simplified morphology, then map the selected simplified root coordinate back to the full morphology.

coordinate_alignment_and_scaling.mechanism: Centers coordinates on the mean, rotates them with snap_to_axis(), and can apply coordinate_scale() with an explicit scale parameter s. The function can transform neuron and synapse coordinates together.

axis_scaling.mechanism: Applies scalar or per-axis scaling; with invert=True the coordinates are divided by the supplied factors.

historical_relationship_to_point_data.relation: The legacy repository predates the Point_data artifact by about four months and contains relevant morphology operations. However, no examined artifact or commit directly links this legacy implementation to the December 2025 Point_data execution.

proven: A public legacy NeuRosetta implementation existed before December 2025 with subtree extraction, simplification, nearest-vertex mapping, SWC writing, and explicit coordinate rotation/scaling functionality.
The July 2025 subtree fix explicitly changed optimal_partition_root() to map the selected simplified root back to the full neuron by coordinate.
The legacy implementation therefore cannot be excluded as a technically plausible predecessor for the missing historical morphology pipeline.
not_proven: The December 2025 Point_data generator used this legacy repository.
Any exact legacy commit was installed in the historical environment.
The Point_data root coordinates were generated by align_neuron(), coordinate_scale(), or any specific parameterization.
The current project's four SWCs are byte-identical to the historical morphology inputs.
interpretation.next_target: Search for the exact historical notebook/environment or an archived local materialization that binds a concrete legacy NeuRosetta commit to the December 2025 Point_data artifact.
